prompt: src/limiter.js exports createLimiter(max), which returns run(fn): it runs async job functions with at most `max` running at the same time. In production it sometimes runs more than max jobs at once. Find the root cause and fix it. Required behaviour: never more than max running at once, jobs start in the order run() was called (FIFO), run() resolves or rejects with the job result, a job that throws or rejects (including a synchronous throw) must free its slot, createLimiter(0) or a non-integer throws RangeError. Keep the public API. Add a test in tests/ that reproduces the bug. Run with `node --test`.
